CEProjectAreaUsageList.description: CEProjectAreaUsageList stores usage flag labels in bit-position order.

usage.description: Items are the names shown by CEProject for usage flags.

CEProjectAreaValueList.description: CEProjectAreaValueList stores value flag labels in bit-position order.

value.description: Items are the names shown by CEProject for value flags.

CEProjectAreas.description: CEProjectAreas stores the ordered flag labels displayed in the editor.

usages.description:
Usages defines labels for area usage bits.
The list order corresponds to bit positions in `layers/layer@usage_flags`.

values.description:
Values defines labels for area value bits, commonly used for loot tiers.
The list order corresponds to bit positions in `layers/layer@value_flags`.

CEProjectBackground.description: CEProjectBackground stores the editor map preview image and its tint.

file.description: File is the map image path opened for the editor preview.

rgba.description: RGBA is the packed color tint applied to the preview image.

CEProjectBrush.description: CEProjectBrush stores the editor's current painting tool settings.

color.description: Color is the packed fill color used to preview the brush.

outline.description: Outline controls whether the brush preview draws an outline.

outline_color.description: OutlineColor is the packed color used for the brush preview outline.

outline_width.description: OutlineWidth is the brush preview outline width.

size.description: Size is the brush size used when painting source masks.

CEProjectConfigFile.description: CEProjectConfigFile is a CEProject workspace file (`mapname.xml`).

areas.description:
Areas declares the usage and value labels available in the editor.
Their order maps labels to bit positions in layer masks.

brush.description: Brush stores editor painting defaults; it is not an area-flags layer.

global.description: Global defines the map preview and the raster and world dimensions used by the project.

layers.description: Layers maps named source masks to usage/value masks and editor display properties.

selected.description: Selected stores editor selection state and does not describe map data.

territory-type-list.description:
TerritoryTypeList embeds territory definitions in the project file.
CEProject may rewrite this section from the separate territory XML files when saving or exporting the project.

zg-config.description: XMLName identifies the CEProject document root.

CEProjectDimension.description: CEProjectDimension stores a dimension value from a CEProject `size` attribute.

size.description: Size is the raster or world dimension, depending on its parent element.

CEProjectGlobal.description: CEProjectGlobal stores map preview metadata and project dimensions.

background.description: Background selects and tints the map image shown in the editor.

layer.description: Layer.Size is the width and height of the square area-flags raster.

world.description: World.Size is the world-map extent used to relate raster cells to map coordinates.

CEProjectLayer.description: CEProjectLayer describes one source mask and how its painted cells contribute to the compiled area-flags map.

color.description: Color is the packed color used to display this layer in the editor.

name.description: Name identifies the layer and provides the base name for its source mask.

usage_flags.description: UsageFlags is the decimal bitmask of usage flags written by this layer.

value_flags.description: ValueFlags is the decimal bitmask of value flags written by this layer.

visible.description: Visible controls editor visibility only; it does not change the compiled area-flags data.

CEProjectLayers.description: CEProjectLayers stores named source-mask layers used to paint area flags.

layer.description: Layers associate source mask files with area-flag bitmasks.

CEProjectSelected.description: CEProjectSelected stores the editor's current row selection.

row.description: Row is the selected row value persisted by the editor.

CEProjectTerritory.description: CEProjectTerritory stores one named territory and its editor display state.

color.description: Color is the packed display color used for the territory.

name.description: Name identifies this territory in the editor and exported XML.

visible.description: Visible controls whether the territory is drawn in the editor.

zone.description: Zones define the named spawn areas and their static/dynamic population limits.

CEProjectTerritoryType.description: CEProjectTerritoryType groups territories under the type name used for a separate territory definition file.

name.description: Name is the territory type identifier and commonly matches the output file name, such as `sheep_goat_territories`.

territory.description: Territories are the named regions and their spawn zones for this type.

CEProjectTerritoryTypeList.description: CEProjectTerritoryTypeList stores territory definitions embedded in the editor project.

territory-type.description:
Types stores individual `<territory-type>` entries.
CEProject save/export may rewrite this section from `territoryTypes/*.xml`.

CEProjectTerritoryZone.description: CEProjectTerritoryZone stores one circular spawn area in a territory.

d.description:
D is an optional CEProject zone attribute.
Its runtime meaning is not established by the available format references.

dmax.description: DMax is the maximum number of dynamic members allowed in this zone.

dmin.description: DMin is the minimum number of dynamic members maintained in this zone.

name.description: Name identifies the zone's role, such as `Graze`, `Rest`, or `Water`.

r.description: R is the zone radius in world units.

smax.description: SMax is the maximum number of static members allowed in this zone.

smin.description: SMin is the minimum number of static members maintained in this zone.

x.description: X is the zone center's world X coordinate.

z.description: Z is the zone center's world Z coordinate.

NamedRef.description: NamedRef stores the name attribute used by CE reference elements such as usage, category, tag, value, type, and group.

name.description: Name is the identifier referenced by the containing CE element.
